actions_amounts_check.name: actions_amounts_check
actions_amounts_check.value: ("actions"."hours" is null or "actions"."hours" >= 0) and ("actions"."estimated_cost" is null or "actions"."estimated_cost" >= 0) and ("actions"."actual_cost" is null or "actions"."actual_cost" >= 0)

events_nc_number_check.name: events_nc_number_check
events_nc_number_check.value: "events"."nc_number" is null or ("events"."nc_number" ~ '^NCR-[0-9]{3,}$' and "events"."type" = 'NC' and "events"."keystone_project_code" is not null)
